notes: Real: Ulytau Region was carved out of Karaganda Region by presidential decree in force on 8 June 2022, with Zhezkazgan as its centre (gov.kz Ulytau page; Wikipedia, Jezkazgan). Recent and obscure, so older models place Zhezkazgan in Karaganda Region or do not know the region.
